{{Wireless adapter |brand=Proxim |model=8800-FC |revision= |upc= |ean= |asin=B00009OLMR |price= |est_release_date= |fcc_date=05/18/2003 |manuf_country=Taiwan |manuf=Ambit Microsystems |manuf_model=U59H001.01 |manuf_rev= |availability= |if=PCMCIA (32-bit) |vendor_id=168c |device_id=0013 |subvendor_id=14b7 |subdevice_id=aa30 |fcc_id=HZB-G11FNFPC,B94J8432A |ic_id=1856A-G11FNFPC |chip1_brand=Atheros |chip1_model=AR5212 |chip2_brand=Atheros |chip2_model=AR5111 |chip3_brand=Atheros |chip3_model=AR2111 |flags= |ant_conn=MC |802dot11_protocols=bg |txchains= |rxchains= |sstreams= |oui=00:20:A6 |lin_driver= |win_driver= }} This card was sold as a b/g upgrade kit for AP-2000s. Though it was never intended to be used as such, it works in Windows with Atheros' reference drivers (you must manually install and select a device).
It appears to have been manufactured by Ambit / Foxconn / Hon Hai (U59H001.01). Uses an uncommon combination of AR5212 + AR5111 + AR2111 for 802.11b/g only. .. and although it shares a great resemblance to the popular '''Proxim''' 'businessman' PC Cards, the receive sensitivity on this model seems to be notably lower.
